verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Jules runs in a virtual machine where it clones your code, installs dependencies, and modifies files. It also automatically reads AGENTS.md from the repo root, which can guide its setup. One community user notes that bespoke, machine-specific build scripts don't carry over to the cloud VM, which is a limitation rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the environment is configured (setup scripts, customization), independent hands-on corroboration of automatic dependency installation, handling of non-standard build environments.
